items.title: AP raises semiconductor incentives, offers up to 80% support for silicon fabs
items.summary: The Andhra Pradesh government has amended its Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy 4.0 to align it with the second phase of the India Semiconductor Mission (ISM 2.0), offering state incentives that match Union support for several project categories. The amendment, notified through G.O.Ms.No.87 on November 16, provides combined Union and State incentives of up to 80% of eligible capital costs for silicon fabrication projects, with each government contributing 40%. Compound semiconductor, photonics, sensor, discrete semiconductor and display fabrication projects, as well as advanced packaging units, will be eligible for combined support of up to 70%. Legacy packaging units can receive up to 50%, according to the policy details. For assembly, testing, marking and packaging (ATMP) and outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) facilities, Andhra Pradesh will match 100% of the Centre’s capital support. The state will also provide a deployment-linked incentive of 4.5% of net sales, in addition to the Union’s 9%, taking the combined incentive to 13.5%.
